'''Leisure Garden''' was a public garden in the [[Axial Park]] district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Leisure Garden featured a number of [[Holostatue/Legends|holostatues]] that commemorated the heroes of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the companions of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Empire deployed a number of artillery pieces in Leisure Garden, and also sabotaged the holostatues. Republic forces eventually destroyed the artillery and restored the holostatues.
